effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's next turn, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.).
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you use an Option card with a cost of 2 or more, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
